title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to NVDA from “Nvidia raises its fiscal-2028 outlook above 75%”

The November beat-and-raise did not lift the shares: they fell 5.2% beyond the factors from Nov 11 to Nov 18 (window) because leadership and export questions dominated. A second raise helps more if those have eased by February; I allow 5% beyond what the shares would otherwise do.
